depends_on: circulant determinant = product of DFT eigenvalues (Mathlib)
notes: Circulant: eigenvalues lambda_k = Sum_{e|gcd(k,n)} e phi(n/e) > 0; lambda_0 = Sum_{d|n} phi(d) n/d, lambda_k = phi(n) for gcd(k,n)=1; local factors (b+1)p^{a-1}(p-1) or p^{a-1}((a+1)p-a) have all prime factors < n for composite n. check.py: product formula = determinant, n<=30. Outside Lean: the circulant argument (standard eigenvalue formula), written out in the README.

prior_art.note: No proof found; circulant diagonalisation is classical, so the proof is immediate.
